## by parse (the path serving had)
  open+parse+model (the share the artifact removes): p50 432µs, p95 7.45ms, p99 23.943ms, mean 1.897ms (n=1000)
  whole-document lookup:                            p50 453µs, p95 7.701ms, p99 24.037ms, mean 1.941ms (n=1000)
  addressed lookup:                                 p50 613µs, p95 7.625ms, p99 24.024ms, mean 2.073ms (n=369)
  one hit's unit text (snippet, proximity):         p50 618µs, p95 7.976ms, p99 24.975ms, mean 2.129ms (n=369)

## by artifact (the path serving has when one is built)
  whole-document lookup:                            p50 67µs, p95 667µs, p99 1.929ms, mean 186µs (n=1000)
  addressed lookup:                                 p50 68µs, p95 833µs, p99 1.524ms, mean 175µs (n=369)
  one hit's unit text, cold:                        p50 71µs, p95 804µs, p99 1.492ms, mean 178µs (n=369)
  one hit's unit text, already read this query:     p50 71µs, p95 813µs, p99 1.518ms, mean 178µs (n=369)
  artifact: 1000 documents, 7.6 MB, built in 2.457s; cache held 1000 payloads in 34.1 MB of 1048.6 MB, 1476 hits, 1000 misses, 0 drops

## the difference, same run and same sample
  whole-document lookup: p50 454µs -> 67µs (6.8x), mean 1.941ms -> 186µs (10.4x)
  addressed lookup:      p50 613µs -> 68µs (9.0x), mean 2.073ms -> 175µs (11.8x)
  unit text per hit:     p50 618µs -> 71µs cold (8.7x), 71µs when the same document was already read this query
  payload cache saves the seek and one frame decompression: 0.00µs of the 178µs an artifact read costs.
    On documents this size the win is over the XML parse, not over the cache.
  answers differing between the two paths: 0 of 1369, snippets: 0 of 369
  not moved: an as_of answer still consolidates and parses, pending M012T011

## addresses the shipped unitiser cites
  369 of 1000 queried documents yielded a cited address; 0 of those (0%) do not open through lookup, on either path

  startup index build is 1.493s over 191429 documents, which is why it is rebuilt
  at boot rather than cached; the cost a query feels is the read, and that
